alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: User: <ARN_1> is not authorized to perform

root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm likely transient/config noise, not real outage. Tasks_running == tasks_desired (2/2), zero pending, zero failed deployments, CPU ~0.5%, mem ~65%. One deployment in flight, no recent-deploy record, no logs captured. Possible causes: alarm threshold miscalibrated, brief blip during in-flight deployment self-corrected, or alarm fired on stale/incomplete metric window before steady state.
